heading: Notable matters
intro: Selected engagements that can be shared publicly, with details anonymised to protect client confidentiality.

matters.title: Restructuring a supply agreement
matters.summary: Advised a mid-sized manufacturer on renegotiating a long-term supply contract, protecting a key supplier relationship while reducing the client’s exposure.

matters.title: Resolving a commercial title dispute
matters.summary: Represented a landlord in a dispute over competing claims to commercial premises, from document review through to negotiated settlement.
matters.outcome: Title confirmed and matter resolved by consent.

matters.title: Workplace restructuring and compliance
matters.summary: Guided an employer through a restructuring exercise, updating contracts and policies and documenting each step to meet legal requirements.
matters.outcome: Restructuring completed with no claims filed.

matters.title: Estate administration and planning
matters.summary: Supported a family through the administration of an estate and prepared a succession plan to prevent future disputes between heirs.
matters.outcome: Estate settled and succession plan put in place.

matters.title: Mediated shareholder settlement
matters.summary: Acted for a minority shareholder in a mediation over governance and exit terms, keeping the business operating throughout.

note: These examples are illustrative summaries shared with client consent. Past outcomes do not guarantee or predict the result of any future matter.
